summary.ru: Австро-Венгрия — многонациональное государство в Центральной Европе, существовавшее в 1867—1918 годах; реальная уния Австрии и Венгрии на последнем этапе правления монархии Габсбургов.
summary.en: Austria-Hungary, also referred to as the Austro-Hungarian Empire and officially as the Austro-Hungarian Monarchy, was a multi-national empire in Central Europe under a constitutional dual monarchy that existed between 1867 and 1918. A military and diplomatic real union, it consisted of two largely self governing states with a single monarch who was titled both the Emperor of Austria and the Apostolic King of Hungary.
